exemplars.question: heart rate > 120 in the last 3 hours
exemplars.sql: SELECT DISTINCT m."patientRef" FROM public."MeasurementsMock" m WHERE m."MeasurementTypeId" = 1 AND m."Value" > 120 AND m."RecordedAt" >= now() - INTERVAL '3 hours' LIMIT 1000

exemplars.question: patients admitted yesterday
exemplars.sql: SELECT v."visitRef", v."patientRef", v."admittedAt" FROM public."VisitMock" v WHERE v."admittedAt" >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' AND v."admittedAt" < CURRENT_DATE LIMIT 1000
